context_requirements: No annotated molecular targets are listed for this mechanism class in the Drug Repurposing Hub.
The nine cell lines are non-neuronal and do not represent the CNS context in which psychoactive drugs act.
A transcriptional response would require expression of the relevant neuronal receptors or transporters, which is not expected in these lines.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h in one or more of the nine cell lines.
Enrichment of a specific pathway among changed landmark genes that is consistent across multiple psychoactive drugs.
Clear separation of psychoactive drugs from vehicle controls in the 978-gene space.
